title: Stochastic Force Inference (SFI)
description:
A JAX-based Python library for inferring force and diffusion fields from stochastic trajectory data (overdamped and underdamped Langevin dynamics), with closed-form linear estimators and noise-robust parametric estimators, sparse model selection (PASTIS), interacting-particle and spatially-extended systems, simulation, and diagnostics.
